places.name: Minton's Playhouse
places.connection: Minton's Playhouse is a famous jazz club where many bebop musicians, such as Thelonious Monk and Charlie Parker, performed and developed the bebop style.

places.name: Birdland Jazz Club
places.connection: Named after Charlie 'Bird' Parker, Birdland was a central hub for bebop musicians and fans during the 1940s and 1950s.

places.name: The Royal Roost
places.connection: The Royal Roost was a jazz club where many bebop musicians, including Dizzy Gillespie and Miles Davis, performed.

places.name: Savoy Ballroom
places.connection: The Savoy Ballroom was a venue where bebop musicians would gather and perform, contributing to the development of the genre.
